head: WORKTREE
summary: Framework-free domain types match the brief. Money uses long plus Currency with exact arithmetic, normal sides and sign-derived posting direction are correct, and every criterion has a named test. Tests pass (51/51). Only minor test gaps remain.

findings.description: Null currency code (Money.of(1, null)) is not tested; it throws NullPointerException while other bad codes throw InvalidCurrencyException. Inconsistent and unproven.
findings.suggestion: Decide the exception for a null code and add a test.

findings.description: Credit-normal balanceFromNet with Long.MIN_VALUE (negate overflow) is not tested at Account level, only at Money level.
